title: Voucher issued
description: A reward redemption issued a single-use voucher. Loyalty only issues and consumes vouchers: delivering the reward (a POS discount, a gift, a Billing coupon) is the Tenant's job, from its own mapping of `rewardId`, typically in its handler of this event. The event's `aggregate` is `member/<memberId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

voucherId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the voucher.

code.description: The single-use voucher code the Tenant's system redeems.

rewardId.description: The reward the voucher was issued for; the Tenant maps it to what it grants.

redemptionId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the reward redemption that issued the voucher.

memberId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the member.

externalRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the member.

expiresAt.description: When the voucher stops being usable, in UTC.
